generic_checks.scope: Complete local pairs for both exits, ordinary and paired paths, all prescribed shortcut parities, inverse replay, and the contraction boundary checkpoints.

complete_paths.scope: Complete weighted N and S paths, four checkpoints each, earlier separated windows and both final exits. At R>=26 inverse trees are complete at min(k,8), not always at k. No earliest-meeting assertion.

modular_checks.scope: Both residues and all exact binary valuations are checked with modular powers. No pure starting value or pure trajectory is materialized; the lift itself permits r<5.
